promise: Keep scoped evidence and derived facts retrievable beyond one agent session.
audience: People and agents who need inspectable, durable project memory.
trigger: Remember, retrieve, revise or inspect durable project evidence.

modes.name: Remember
modes.output: Verbatim evidence scoped to its project and source.

modes.name: Retrieve
modes.when: A current task needs relevant past evidence.
modes.output: Scoped source-linked results with currency qualified.

modes.name: Maintain
modes.when: A claim changed or retained records need review.
modes.output: Explicit supersession, export or authorized forgetting.

examples.title: Fictional worked example
examples.before: A remembered conclusion is reused as current fact with no source.
examples.after: Scoped evidence and a provenance-linked superseding fact preserve what was known and when.
examples.why: Durable retrieval stays separate from unverified claims of current truth.

boundaries: Portable method installation is independent; native persistence depends on the separate amplifier-data substrate and supported adapters.

verification.name: Functional acceptance
verification.expected: Supplied fictional tasks exercise actual mechanisms and failure boundaries.
verification.evidence: 573 native module tests passed, 4 skips; actual native two-consumer and no-host evidence checks also passed. Private foundation access remains a distribution gate.

verification.name: Native host acceptance
verification.expected: Actual provider/host/desktop/daemon/runner acceptance for the selected adapter.
verification.evidence: No live model, real desktop transaction, invitation, deployment or production data migration was performed by this functional baseline.

verification.name: Storage ownership and runtime
verification.expected: Identify the separately owned private foundation and native durability.
verification.evidence: Actual amplifier-data 0.2.0 Rust kernel installed locally; no user store opened or migrated. Public source access remains unavailable.

sources.role: Primary retained owner history, mechanisms and records; portable method consolidates the listed entry points.

consolidation: One portable method entry with mode references; original native engines, agents and records retained as optional adapters.
